Name: Anime Portrait of Ridgeside Village
Author: CNSnf
Description:
[left][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/left]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod imitates the art style of another beautification mod, primarily "Manch's Fisharia anime portraits," based on personal preference. However, my hand-drawing skills are limited, so the style may not be perfectly identical. If needed, you can use this mod alongside the original.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Mod link: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21356[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]To use this mod, download and extract the archive, then replace the original portraits with the beautified ones. Each subfolder is named after the file path where the original portraits are located.[/color]
